step_1_rehydration.note_on_the_full_parent: the prior traversal recorded 420 Mbit/s aggregate, implying ~8 hours for 1.507 TB. Measured now at ~2.0 Gbit/s, a full rehydration is roughly 1.7 hours. That materially changes what a heavy window buys.
step_1_rehydration.why_a_window_and_not_the_parent: the campaign's own ordering is pilot on representative windows, freeze one global program, then traverse and pack. Fetching 1.507 TB and packing for ~13 hours under a program that has not passed a gate is the expensive mistake available here.
step_1_rehydration.representativeness: shards 1-5 carry every organ class the flagship has: embedding, lm_head, attention, dense MLP, routed experts, shared expert.

measurable: functional preservation of an organ under a proxy input distribution

not_measurable.G_math: four layers of seventy-eight cannot complete '2 + 2 ='
not_measurable.G_halo: needs the whole model and a served endpoint
not_measurable.G_cascade: needs many more layers than this window carries

scope_of_a_window_pilot.why_this_is_stated_prominently: a window result is not a capability result. Treating one as the other is precisely how a byte-perfect Math-Preserve came to be called ready.

the_correction_that_made_the_pilot_meani.first_run: every arm ran at the hyperparameters chosen for a 64x64 synthetic fixture. On real 2048x12288 GLM organs those are meaningless -- A1 at rank 4 landed at 0.036 BPW and destroyed the organ, A2 stored an unpriced float16 residual and landed at 16 BPW while reproducing it perfectly.
the_correction_that_made_the_pilot_meani.why_it_mattered: neither number is a result about the arm; both are results about defaults. Reporting them as arm outcomes would have been a false negative for A1 and a false positive for A2.
the_correction_that_made_the_pilot_meani.fix: every arm was given an explicit rate knob and swept, producing a rate-distortion curve in FUNCTIONAL space.

measured_rate_distortion_dense_mlp.null_meaning: a predictor emitting the mean row scores this well while carrying no information. A cosine at or below it is worse than useless.

best_sub_bit_point.reading: it beats the null by roughly 2.3x and still gets the organ's output 96 percent wrong. That is an organ that no longer does its job.

measured_rate_distortion_dense_mlp.the_shape: function degrades catastrophically below about 1 BPW, and improves markedly just above it. Crossing from 0.58 BPW to 1.13 BPW roughly doubles the cosine, from 0.283 to 0.592.

what_this_supports: Organ sensitivity varies enormously under sub-bit compression: attn_o retains cosine 0.692 at 0.563 BPW while dense_mlp retains 0.283 at 0.583 BPW, against nulls near 0.12.
A uniform sub-bit rate is therefore the wrong program for this parent, and per-organ functional allocation is an untried and cheaper direction than a BPW escape.
Protected islands are not the missing ingredient: every sub-bit A5 configuration falls below the null, and placement only begins to matter above 1 BPW.
This is measured, functional, on the real flagship parent, swept across rate -- not weight-space reconstruction error, which both the frozen tournament and the sub-bit law rule inadmissible.
what_this_does_NOT_support: that sub-bit is impossible for this parent. These are straightforward implementations of four families. A materially better A1 -- fitted to captured activations rather than SVD of raw weights, or with per-row scaling -- has not been tried, and the sub-bit law requires representation escalation to be genuinely exhausted before an escape is considered.
any whole-model claim. No whole-model gate is measurable on a four-layer window.
promotion of any arm. Promotion needs the whole-model gates.
that A6 fails. It is DATA_BLOCKED on trajectory traces, of which the teacher ledger holds zero.
next_actions_in_order: replicate the activation-aware result across many experts and several layers using the 66 retained teacher capsules
if it holds, freeze an activation-fitted allocation program and run measurement shardwise -> allocation global -> packing shardwise
re-probe the resulting artifact with 2 + 2 and prompt-dependent generation before anything trains on it
the Escape Receipt is OFF the table until data-aware fitting has been genuinely exhausted, which it has not even been started at scale

fences_unchanged.substrate_capability_gate: REFUSING the current Math-Preserve by hash

A5_decoder_implemented_and_measured.why_it_mattered: A5 could be priced but not judged, and pricing without judging is the trap: Math-Preserve spends 67,526,197,248 bytes on protected islands and still cannot complete '2 + 2 ='. Whether islands help is a functional question no byte count answers.
A5_decoder_implemented_and_measured.finding: EVERY sub-bit A5 configuration is BELOW the constant-mean null. Protected islands do not preserve this organ's function at sub-bit rates, at any protection fraction that stays sub-bit.

island_placement_control.design: identical byte cost, importance-chosen rows versus random rows
island_placement_control.correction_to_my_own_first_reading: My first control printed 'placement MATTERS' from a 1.058x ratio at 5 percent protection. That label was wrong: at 5 percent BOTH configurations sit below the null, so the difference is between two useless configurations. A ratio test without a null check will call noise a result, which is the exact error the null exists to prevent.
island_placement_control.corrected_answer_to_the_live_question: Placement is NOT the binding issue at sub-bit rates. Islands only begin to help once the artifact is already above 1 BPW (10 to 20 percent protection), and by 40 percent importance is no better than random. So the hypothesis that Math-Preserve's 67.5 GB of islands were merely in the wrong PLACES is not supported: at sub-bit rates, what is destroyed is everything OUTSIDE the islands, and no placement of a 5 percent island rescues it.

CORRECTION_all_four_organs.what_i_previously_wrote: 'At sub-bit rates every swept configuration of four materially different families destroys the organ's function on the real parent.'
CORRECTION_all_four_organs.why_that_was_wrong: It generalised from dense_mlp alone, which the completed sweep shows is the OUTLIER rather than the rule. Reporting one organ's curve as the parent's behaviour is the same shape of error as reporting a window result as a capability result.
CORRECTION_all_four_organs.the_actual_finding: Organ sensitivity to sub-bit compression varies by roughly 2.4x in preserved function at essentially the same rate. attn_o holds cosine 0.692 at 0.563 BPW; dense_mlp holds 0.283 at 0.583 BPW. Attention-out and embedding survive sub-bit substantially; dense MLP does not.
CORRECTION_all_four_organs.what_this_changes: The recommendation reverses. A UNIFORM sub-bit rate is the wrong program, and the headroom that has not been explored is ALLOCATION, not escape. Spending more bits on dense MLP and fewer on attention and embedding is exactly the 'measurement shardwise -> allocation global -> packing shardwise' step, and it has never been driven by measured per-organ FUNCTIONAL sensitivity.
CORRECTION_all_four_organs.what_it_says_about_math_preserve: Math-Preserve allocated by profile and by tensor role. It did not allocate by measured functional sensitivity per organ. That is a live, untried direction and it is cheaper than any escape.
CORRECTION_all_four_organs.escape_receipt_status: NOT the next step, and further from justified than before this sweep. The sub-bit law demands representation escalation be exhausted first, and a measured allocation program is precisely an unexhausted avenue.

DECISIVE_routed_expert_sweep.why_this_was_the_deciding_measurement: Routed experts carry ~97.5 percent of GLM-5.2's mass. Whether per-organ allocation can rescue a sub-bit pack depends entirely on whether the MASSIVE organs are the sensitive ones.
DECISIVE_routed_expert_sweep.the_answer: Routed experts behave like dense_mlp, not like attention. At ~0.67 BPW they retain cosine ~0.30 with 95 percent relative output error. The organs that SURVIVE sub-bit -- attn_o at 0.692, embed at 0.617 -- sit inside the ~2.5 percent of mass that is not experts.

the_arithmetic_that_settles_allocation.premise: experts ~97.5 percent of mass; everything that survives sub-bit is in the remaining ~2.5 percent
the_arithmetic_that_settles_allocation.reading: Allocation can save at most about 2.5 percent of the budget, because the cheap organs are the small ones. Whole-model BPW is pinned to whatever the experts need, and at 0.667 BPW the experts are 95 percent wrong.

correction_to_my_own_previous_correction.what_i_wrote_an_hour_ago: 'A uniform sub-bit rate is the wrong program and the unexplored headroom is ALLOCATION rather than escape. The Escape Receipt is further from justified than before.'
correction_to_my_own_previous_correction.why_that_was_premature: It was written from four organs, none of which was a routed expert. Allocation headroom is real but tiny, because the sensitive organs ARE the massive ones. I generalised twice from partial organ coverage -- first from dense_mlp alone, then from four non-expert organs -- and both times the next measurement moved the conclusion.
correction_to_my_own_previous_correction.the_lesson_worth_keeping: On a MoE parent, no organ-level claim means anything until the routed experts are measured, because they are effectively the whole model by mass.

DECISIVE_routed_expert_sweep.what_this_now_supports: Sub-bit compression of THIS parent is bounded by its experts, and at measured sub-bit rates the experts do not function. Math-Preserve shipped at 0.9774 BPW -- almost exactly the 0.9825 that experts-at-1.0-BPW would imply -- and is semantically collapsed. That is consistent with the experts having been the binding constraint all along.
what_it_still_does_not_establish: that no representation can compress a GLM expert sub-bit. A1 is SVD of raw weights; an expert fitted against captured activations, or exploiting inter-expert redundancy at scale (A4 across the real 256-expert bank rather than 8 synthetic blocks), remains untried and is exactly the escalation the law demands before an escape.
any whole-model result. Still a four-layer window, still a proxy input distribution.

A4_across_a_REAL_expert_bank.why_this_was_the_most_promising_untried_: On a MoE parent, 256 routed experts serve the same layer. If they share structure, a shared latent basis exploits redundancy that per-expert compression cannot see at all -- and it is the only arm whose cost per expert FALLS as the bank grows. The pilot had only ever run A4 across 8 synthetic blocks of a single tensor.
A4_across_a_REAL_expert_bank.verdict: NEGATIVE, and cleanly so. A4 at 0.914 BPW returns cosine 0.247; per-expert A1 at 0.667 BPW returns 0.299. The shared basis costs 37 percent MORE and delivers 17 percent LESS.
A4_across_a_REAL_expert_bank.what_it_means: The 70 routed experts sampled here do not share structure a shared linear basis can exploit. Inter-expert redundancy is not the win on this parent -- at least not the linear redundancy an SVD over the expert bank captures. At basis 1, where the shared basis is most aggressive, it sits exactly AT the null.
A4_across_a_REAL_expert_bank.significance_for_the_law: This closes the representation specifically suited to a MoE architecture, which was the strongest remaining sub-bit candidate. Linear representation escalation over routed experts is now measured and exhausted: low-rank per expert, PQ plus residual, additive multi-codebook, protected islands, and shared basis across a real bank have all been swept and none functions sub-bit on the organs that carry the mass.

what_remains_untried_before_an_escape_is: DATA-AWARE fitting: every arm swept so far fits RAW WEIGHTS. Fitting an expert against captured activations optimises what the organ DOES rather than what it stores, and the campaign's own functional-codec work (glm52.functional.moe.v1, GLM52_FUNCTIONAL_CPU_PARITY.json) is exactly that machinery, already frozen and deterministic. It has not been swept as a rate ladder.
A6 trajectory-stabilized, which stays DATA_BLOCKED on parent trajectory traces the teacher ledger does not hold
controller_position_now: The rebuild has a direction, measured and replicated. Activation-aware projection preserves routed-expert function at 0.167 BPW across 12/12 experts while raw-weight low-rank fails 0/12 at four times the rate. Sub-bit is not exhausted; it was never properly attempted against the right objective. The Escape Receipt stays off the table. The next step is a program: measurement shardwise using the retained teacher capsules, allocation global, packing shardwise -- and then the whole-model gates decide.

FUNCTIONAL_codec_rate_sweep.why_it_was_the_last_untried_family: Every other arm fits RAW WEIGHTS, and the sub-bit law explicitly refuses weight-space reasoning. glm52.functional.moe.v1 stores a FUNCTION -- a feature map reproduced from a seed at zero storage cost, plus a fitted readout -- so it answers what the organ DOES rather than what it holds.
FUNCTIONAL_codec_rate_sweep.held_out: fitted on 4096 sampled rows, scored on 512 unseen
FUNCTIONAL_codec_rate_sweep.verdict: NEGATIVE, and by a wide margin. At an identical 0.667 BPW the functional codec returns cosine 0.104 -- BELOW the null -- against low-rank's 0.298 on the same organ. At 10.67 BPW, sixteen times the rate, it reaches 0.320, barely matching what low-rank achieved at 0.667.
FUNCTIONAL_codec_rate_sweep.reading: For this organ a seed-reproduced random feature map is a far worse basis than the organ's own principal directions. The feature map costs nothing to store, which is its appeal, and it also carries no information about this particular expert -- which is why it loses.
FUNCTIONAL_codec_rate_sweep.honest_caveat_that_keeps_this_from_being: The fit used sampled Gaussian activations as a proxy, not the campaign's 47 retained teacher capsules. Fitting against REAL captured activations is a materially different experiment and remains untested. It is the last thing standing between this result and a defensible claim of exhaustion.

swept_and_negative_sub_bit_on_mass_carry: A5 protected islands (decoder implemented this session)
A4 shared latent basis across a REAL 70-expert bank
functional codec with seed-reproduced feature map
remaining_before_exhaustion_is_defensibl: functional fitting against REAL captured activations from the 47 retained teacher capsules, rather than Gaussian proxies
A6 trajectory-stabilized, still DATA_BLOCKED on parent trajectory traces the ledger does not hold
exhaustion_status.controller_position: Six families are now measured negative at sub-bit rates on the organs carrying 97.5 percent of the mass, including the MoE-specific one and the function-fitting one. That is most of the way to the exhaustion the sub-bit law demands. It is not all the way, and the gap is specific and cheap: one experiment against real captured activations. Preparing an Escape Receipt before running it would rest the campaign's largest architectural decision on a Gaussian proxy.

DECISIVE_REVERSAL_real_captured_activati.status: THIS OVERTURNS EVERY SUB-BIT NEGATIVE IN THIS RECEIPT
DECISIVE_REVERSAL_real_captured_activati.what_changed: Every earlier sweep fitted and scored against sampled GAUSSIAN activations. These use the campaign's own retained teacher capsule L10_L10.npz -- 4096 real token activations captured from the real parent at layer 10, which is exactly the input distribution these experts see.

the_first_thing_that_changed.why: real token activations are strongly anisotropic -- they live near a low-dimensional subspace -- so the mean row is a far better predictor than it is under isotropic noise. Every cosine in the Gaussian sweeps was being read against a null five times too small.

measured_at_identical_0.667_BPW_same_exp.verdict: BELOW the null -- raw-weight low-rank is worse than useless on real data

DECISIVE_REVERSAL_real_captured_activati.the_headline: A data-aware projection reaches cosine 0.755 at 0.167 BPW and 0.793 at 0.667 BPW, both sub-bit, both clearly above the 0.651 null. At the same rate raw-weight low-rank returns 0.384 and sits BELOW the null. Knowing where the activations live is worth roughly a doubling of preserved function per bit.
why_the_gaussian_proxy_misled_in_the_dir: it shrank the null five-fold, so weak arms looked like they were clearing a bar
it flattered raw-weight methods, which have nothing to lose when the input is isotropic
it penalised data-aware methods specifically, because an isotropic input has no structure for them to exploit -- the exact property they exist to use

what_this_does_to_the_campaign.sub_bit_is_NOT_exhausted: A working sub-bit representation of a real routed expert now exists and is measured. The five negatives in this receipt were negatives about fitting raw weights under a proxy, not about sub-bit.
what_this_does_to_the_campaign.escape_receipt: DEFINITIVELY NOT the next step. It would have been prepared on the strength of measurements that a better input distribution reverses.
what_this_does_to_the_campaign.the_direction: data-aware allocation -- fit every organ against captured activations, not against its own weights. The campaign has 66 teacher capsules retained and has never used them as the fitting target for a packing program.
what_this_does_to_the_campaign.what_it_suggests_about_math_preserve: if the PASS3 program fitted raw weights rather than activations, it optimised the wrong objective at every one of 59,585 frozen decisions. That is a hypothesis this result makes worth testing, not yet a finding.

honest_limits: one expert, one layer, one tensor kind. It must replicate across experts and layers before a program is frozen on it.
cosine 0.793 against a 0.651 null is a real margin, not an overwhelming one. Whether it is enough to generate is a whole-model question this window cannot answer.
the activation-aware arm here is a simple eigenbasis projection of W onto the top activation directions. It is a demonstration that the DIRECTION works, not a finished codec.

REPLICATION_across_twelve_experts.why: Replication is the gate between a promising measurement and a program worth freezing. One expert is an anecdote.
REPLICATION_across_twelve_experts.activations: layer_10/pre_router_hidden, real captured teacher capsule, 4096 tokens, 80/20 held out
REPLICATION_across_twelve_experts.key_structural_fact: the top 16 activation directions carry 88.9 percent of the variance. Real token activations at this layer live in a subspace far smaller than the 6144-dimensional space the weights are stored in, which is exactly why a representation that knows where they live wins.
REPLICATION_across_twelve_experts.verdict: Unanimous and consistent. Activation-aware projection preserves routed-expert function at 0.167 BPW on every expert tested, and raw-weight low-rank fails on every expert tested at four times that rate. The effect is not an artifact of one expert.
REPLICATION_across_twelve_experts.what_is_now_established: A sub-bit representation of GLM-5.2's routed experts that preserves function above the real-activation null exists, replicates, and costs 0.167 BPW on the organs carrying ~97.5 percent of the model's mass.
what_is_still_NOT_established: that a whole artifact packed this way generates. That needs the full program and the whole-model gates -- 2 + 2, prompt-dependent generation, cascade, halo, long context.

that one layer's activation basis transfers to other layers. These twelve experts all serve layer 10 and were scored against layer 10's activations. Per-layer bases are the obvious design, and the cost of storing them is already counted in the BPW above.
any claim about attention, embedding or lm_head under real activations -- only routed experts were replicated.
